applies_why: The judge text uses Matthew 1:16's passive verb not stating a verdict on the begetter as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the passive egennēthē states no verdict on the begetter in either direction
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: phrase: 'a single verse does not state a link or its contrary'; readings: (1) it bars silence-based UNDERDETERMINED, (2) it permits silence-based UNDERDETERMINED. I adopt (1).
why: Because the judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on a single verse not stating the matter in either direction, which the rule expressly forbids as a ground.
